dataTypes.name: AI-Generated Itineraries
dataTypes.description: Travel itineraries generated by artificial intelligence based on user preferences. Users are informed during onboarding that content is AI-generated.

dataTypes.name: Travel Preferences
dataTypes.description: User-selected interests, food preferences, budget range, and optional travel dates used to personalize AI recommendations.

dataTypes.name: Feedback & Reports
dataTypes.description: User feedback on itineraries (helpful/not helpful) and issue reports (inaccurate, inappropriate content). Required for App Store compliance with AI content moderation.
In-app interactions (screen views, button clicks) used to improve app performance and user experience.
App crash logs and error reports used to identify and fix bugs.
App performance metrics (launch time, API response time) used to optimize app speed.

dataPractices.dataLinkedToUserDescription: Email and travel preferences are linked to user accounts for personalization.
dataPractices.dataUsedToTrackUserDescription: We do not use data for cross-app or cross-site tracking.
dataPractices.userCanRequestDataDeletionDescription: Users can delete their data from Settings → Delete My Data. Deletion is completed within 30 days.

notes.aiTransparency: This app uses artificial intelligence to generate travel recommendations. Users are explicitly informed during onboarding and must consent via checkbox before proceeding. Every itinerary displays an AI disclosure banner. Users can report inaccurate or inappropriate content.
notes.contentModeration: All AI-generated content can be reported by users. Reports are reviewed by our compliance team within 48 hours. We monitor for inaccurate, inappropriate, or missing information.
notes.dataRetention: Account data retained until user deletes account. Itineraries retained for 2 years after last login. Usage logs retained for 90 days. All retention periods comply with GDPR/CCPA.
notes.internationalTransfers: Data is stored in AWS us-east-1 (USA) with backups in us-west-2 (USA). For EU users, Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) are in place for GDPR compliance.
